visualCharacteristics.structure: image + view-more cta + linked heading + pdf pill links
visualCharacteristics.layout: 2-column grid; client-side search, category/letter filter, grid/list toggle, pagination

contentPattern: One row per product, 2 cells: [product image] | [h2 linked product name (href = product detail page), then paragraph links to PDFs: Download Safety Data Sheet / Package Insert / Medication Guide / Package Insert & Med Guide]. Optional 3rd cell: comma-separated categories (enables the category filter). Search inputs, A-Z letter filter, item count, grid/list toggle and pagination (12 per page) are rendered client-side.
